commands.name: DoSPAProjectileAnimation
commands.description: Create an emitter and move it from a start position to a destination position.

params.name: num
params.description: Loaded particle archive slot / particle datID used by the VM.

params.name: index
params.description: Resource index inside the loaded SPA archive.

params.name: move_type
params.description: Emitter movement type; see emitter movement constants below.

params.name: ofs_y
params.description: Y offset applied to the command logic and destination positions.

params.name: top
params.description: Arc height/top value used by curved emitter movement.

params.name: wave
params.description: Wave count/frequency for wave emitter movement. Zero is corrected to 1 by the command logic.

notes: The command expects start and destination to be different. move_type creates an emitter movement callback; wave value 0 is corrected to 1.
For OFFSET movement, the handler swaps start/destination and then offsets destination by start.
Important correction for the preview tool: p2 is move_type, p3 is start_pos, and p4 is end_pos. Treating p2 as a position is what makes many projectile effects originate from the wrong side.
